Subject: Moving our planning meeting

Hi Maya,

Could we move our planning meeting from Tuesday at 10:30 to Wednesday at 14:00? The agenda will stay the same: review the launch checklist, identify unresolved issues, and assign owners. Please do not send the customer announcement until the release checks pass. If Wednesday does not work, reply to alex@example.com and we can find another time.

Thanks,
Alex

The trial does not prove that the treatment works. There were 24 participants, and no control group was included. Three participants reported improvement, but the researchers did not establish whether that change was caused by the treatment. Do not interpret these observations as a recommendation. A larger controlled study would be needed before drawing a causal conclusion.

The endpoint accepts one request at a time. A response with status 503 means that no model generation started for that request. A timeout does not guarantee cancellation: the server may still be completing the original attempt. Reusing the same idempotency key with the same body returns the recorded result during the current process lifetime. After a restart, that in-memory record is gone. Details are at https://example.com/docs.
